open_items.detail: The 1st Term opening list (extractRawText lines 9-51, 22 topics, SHA-256 afccd54e...) has no week numbers and no week markers. Week 1 was mapped to the first three topics (lines 9, 11, 13) because their titles match the Week 1 EKA ISE headings word for word and appear first; the mapping is inferred, not stated. The list also contains one extra topic ("Ogbon itopinpin litireso ede Yoruba", line 31) between the Week 4 ASA topic and the Week 5 topics, which has no matching body part and is most plausibly the Week 4 LITIRESO objective with no body (for YO-WK-T1-W04 to confirm).
